rv.q: A FINE PIECE OF CHILDREN'S THEATRE
A musical (and magical) adaptation, the show is not just a faithful recreation of a favourite book for many young children but also the perfect way to introduce them to the magic of theatre.
In The Gruffalo , Tall Stories successfully capture the magical warmth of the original book while creating an enchanting piece of children’s theatre that will bring a big smile to grown up faces too.

cn.t: Critics praise this beloved adaptation of Julia Donaldson's classic, with strong performances bringing the deep, dark wood to life in a celebration worthy of its 25th anniversary.
